content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Shivamogga Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Merit calculation (Karavasooligar): The merit list is prepared using the percentage/marks scored in whichever of 1a, 1b, 1c, 1d, 1e or 1f the candidate holds. If the candidate additionally has a computer-training qualification under 2a, that is also factored into the merit ranking. The base qualification (options 1a to 1f) is the same as listed above for Karavasooligar – passing 12th standard / an equivalent NIOS course with Kannada as one language. The computer-training requirement differs: Merit calculation (Data Entry Operator): 50% weight is given to the marks scored in the qualifying academic exam (1a to 1f), and 50% weight is given to the score of a computer proficiency test conducted by the recruiting authority; the final merit is based on the combined weighted score. (The computer proficiency test schedule is communicated to shortlisted candidates separately, including by e-mail.)

rows.prescribed_qualification: Passed second PUC (12th) with Kannada as one language
Passed 12th standard CBSE examination with Kannada as one language
Passed 12th standard ICSE board examination with Kannada as one language
Passed Class 12 examination conducted by any other state government education board with Kannada as one language
Passed a higher secondary education course via the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) with Kannada as one language

Passed a 3-year vocational diploma (CPEd/CPTC/ELTC) via NIOS – conducted through distance mode with one language subject and one vocational subject – with Kannada as one language; candidates who cleared all subjects except one in an equivalent-level exam may be treated as provisionally passed

A computer training course certificate of at least 3 months' duration, recognised by the Central or State Government (a certificate from a private institution is acceptable only if endorsed with a Government-recognised certificate)

A computer training course certificate of at least 6 months' duration, recognised by the Central or State Government (a certificate from a private institution is acceptable only if endorsed with a Government-recognised certificate)

content_sections.heading: Zilla Panchayat Shivamogga Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to both posts is on a merit-list basis – there is no written competitive examination mentioned in the notification. Key points: Karavasooligar: Merit rank is based on the percentage of marks scored in the qualifying 12th-standard/equivalent examination (option 1a–1f), with additional weight for a computer-training qualification (2a) where held. Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator: Merit rank is a combined score – 50% weight from the qualifying academic exam marks and 50% weight from a computer proficiency test conducted by the authority. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zilla Panchayat Shivamogga Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website shivamogga.nic.in and download the prescribed application form. Fill the form completely and attach self-attested copies of all required certificates (see Documents section below). Prepare a Demand Draft (DD) for the application fee in favour of "Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat, Shivamogga" . Submit the completed application, along with documents and the DD, to the concerned Grama Panchayat office (the Panchayat Development Officer of the Grama Panchayat where the post is vacant and where the candidate resides) between 27 August 2026 and 25 September 2026. The DD is not verified at the time of application scrutiny but must be produced at the time of final selection/document verification. Important: Only candidates residing within the specific Grama Panchayat where a post is vacant are eligible to apply for that post; a residence certificate issued by the concerned Tahsildar must be submitted along with the application by the last date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Aadhaar card 2 recent passport-size photographs Educational qualification mark sheets / certificates matching the qualification claimed as of the application deadline Birth-date proof – SSLC or equivalent examination certificate, School Leaving Certificate, or Transfer Certificate showing date of birth Caste and reservation certificate, in the prescribed Form D / Form E / Form F as applicable, issued by the concerned Tahsildar Residence certificate from the concerned Tahsildar confirming residence within the Grama Panchayat area of the vacant post Rural-reservation certificate (Form-2 as applicable), where claiming rural quota Kannada-medium study certificate (Form-2 as applicable), where claiming Kannada-medium quota Disability certificate with UDID / District Medical Board proof, where claiming PwD quota (minimum 40% disability) Discharge certificate, pension/gratuity proof, where claiming ex-servicemen quota Computer training course certificate (Government-recognised, or private-institute certificate endorsed by Government)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only from residents of the specific Grama Panchayat where the applied post is vacant. Application fee: ₹50 for SC/ST candidates (proof required, else fee is not refunded) and ₹100 for all other candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat, Shivamogga. Rural-quota candidates must have completed their entire schooling (class 1 to 10) in institutions located within notified rural areas, certified by the concerned Tahsildar along with the school head/institution head, as per Government Order No. SaKaI 59 Shasana 2000 dated 06.01.2001 and Notification-2. Kannada-medium quota candidates must have studied from 1st to 10th standard entirely in Kannada medium in Karnataka schools, as certified per Government Order No. CASuE 71 Shasana 2001 dated 24.10.2002. Certain sub-castes among Hindu communities are included under Category-2A/3A/3B for education and employment purposes as per Government Order No. SaKaI 179 BiSi 2010 dated 16.07.2011; the notification lists these sub-castes in detail (shepherd, weaver, oil-presser, fisherman, potter, toddy-tapper and related occupational sub-castes, among others) – candidates should verify their sub-caste against the official notification. Ex-servicemen reservation (10%) is governed by Government Orders DPAR 13 SRR 92 dated 01.04.1992 and DPAR 28 SRR 95 dated 21.10.1995, under the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977; specific eligibility conditions for ex-servicemen and their dependents are detailed in the notification. Persons with disability (PwD) reservation applies only to candidates with 40% or more disability, as per Government Order No. WCD 213 PHP 2023 dated 06.02.2024; a UDID / competent-authority disability certificate must be submitted by the application deadline. Age relaxation does not automatically apply to all disability categories – refer to Government Order No. CASuE/115/SENE/2005 dated 19.11.2005 for applicable categories. If original documents on verification do not match the reservation category (caste/rural/Kannada-medium) claimed in the application, the candidate's reservation-category claim will be cancelled and they will be considered only under the General merit category, if otherwise eligible. Candidates already in Government service, or who have already availed of a Government job/exam opportunity in the past under similar terms, must submit the relevant No-Objection Certificate / prior-employment proof along with the application, where applicable. Furnishing false information or documents in the application will lead to rejection at any stage and may attract legal action. The recruiting authority reserves the right to modify, postpone or cancel the recruitment process, or change the number of posts.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are available in this Zilla Panchayat Shivamogga recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 52 posts – 21 Karavasooligar (Bill Collector) and 31 Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator – across Grama Panchayats in 7 taluks of Shivamogga district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted at the concerned Grama Panchayat office by 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply for a post in any Grama Panchayat?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only from candidates residing within the specific Grama Panchayat where the post is vacant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A pass in 12th standard/PUC (or an equivalent NIOS/other-board qualification) with Kannada as one language; the Data Entry Operator post additionally requires a computer-training certificate of at least 6 months.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years; maximum age ranges from 40 years (General) to 45 years (SC/ST/Category-1), with further relaxation for ex-servicemen and persons with disability.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No written exam is mentioned. Selection is via a merit list based on qualifying-exam marks (and a computer proficiency test for the Data Entry Operator post).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹50 for SC/ST candidates and ₹100 for all other candidates, payable by Demand Draft in favour of the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat, Shivamogga.
